column2: The Making of a Story: A Norton Guide to Creative Writing
column7: A writing teacher compiles fifteen years of her expertise, exercieses, and examples in a new primer for creative writers. This text provides a guide to the basics of creative writing - both fiction and creative nonfiction.

A year after the mysterious 1924 Everest disaster, three climbers embark on a rescue mission that becomes a fight for survival against an unknown terror hidden high on the mountain.
